ازدرعتا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَعَتَا (izdaraʕatā) /iz.da.ra.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اُزْدُرِعَتَا (uzduriʕatā) /uz.du.ri.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
